Name: White Dwarf
Description: White Dwarf hails from Earth-1010, an alternate reality in which Nightcrawler and Rogue are the only surviving members of the X-Men. Recruited into the X-Men three months prior to his eleventh birthday, White Dwarf is considered to be a pre-adoloescent powerhouse. The young mutant is super-strong and super-dense and possesses a high-level intellect geared towards problem-solving.
